title: Michael Borck's World
subtitle: An interactive map of a career
summary: AI Leader and Cyber Security expert with 25+ years spanning military → academia → industry consulting transition. Author of the Conversation, Not Delegation book series, creator of innovative educational AI tools, and pioneer in AI-enhanced pedagogy serving academics, education, agriculture and mining sectors. Founder of LocoLabo, an applied local-AI research lab, with a rare combination of technical depth and educational innovation expertise. Teaching philosophy grounded in three conceptual pillars - Caring, Competence, and Passion, with a core principle of "Make Contact Count."
